presets.title: T83 — IG Farbenindustrie A.G. records
presets.description: Captured records of the German chemical conglomerate, ~1916–1945. Microform publication T83 in RG 242; ~255k digital objects across hundreds of File Units.

presets.title: M892 — United States v. Carl Krauch et al. (IG Farben Trial)
presets.description: Case VI of the Subsequent Nuremberg Proceedings. Trial transcripts, briefs, prosecution and defense exhibits against 24 IG Farben executives.

presets.title: NI Document Series (Nuremberg Industrialists)
presets.description: Evidentiary documents gathered by US prosecutors for the industrialists' trials (Cases V, VI, X). Heavy on internal IG Farben memos, Vorstand minutes, slave-labor contracts.

presets.title: OMGUS decartelization — IG Farben dissolution
presets.description: Records of the US Military Government in Germany on breaking up IG Farben into successor companies (BASF, Bayer, Hoechst) after 1945.

presets.title: IG Auschwitz / Monowitz / Buna-Werke
presets.description: Records on IG Farben's Auschwitz III (Monowitz) slave-labor camp and the Buna synthetic-rubber plant — built and operated using prisoners from the SS.

presets.title: Captured German records (RG 242) — overview
presets.description: Top-level Series in RG 242 — the Allies' seized cache of Nazi-era German government, party, and industry records. Good starting point to orient before drilling in.

presets.title: Subsequent Nuremberg Proceedings — all 12 cases
presets.description: The US-only follow-on trials after the International Military Tribunal: Medical (I), Milch (II), Justice (III), Pohl (IV), Flick (V), IG Farben (VI), Hostages (VII), RuSHA (VIII), Einsatzgruppen (IX), Krupp (X), Ministries (XI), High Command (XII).

presets.title: T120 — German Foreign Office archives
presets.description: Captured records of the Auswärtiges Amt. Useful for IG Farben's foreign operations, currency-clearing, and wartime trade — references to the firm appear throughout.
